contribution.position: On reliability, the evidence points against the change as it stands. The perf report measures peak CPU at 93% at peak load against a 70% budget, so there is almost no headroom. The incident log shows two sev2 incidents last quarter, both caused by retry storms. A job running near CPU saturation is the condition under which retries pile up and cascade, so the two findings compound. The passing test report (412 passed, 0 failed, 87% coverage) shows functional correctness. Nothing in the artifacts shows it exercised retry or backoff behavior under peak load. Missing evidence: a load test at peak showing retry behavior stays bounded, with CPU back inside budget or the overage explicitly accepted, and confirmation that the retry-storm root causes from last quarter are fixed or capped.
